ravi: noticing p95/p99 spikes in apac-sg GPU hosts since ~02:10 UTC. hosts=h-12,h-13. slab churn + nvlink retries. suspect tenant=recommender-prod. :thinking:
dana: can you post top allocs and PCIe counters?
infra-bot: [ALERT] slab_churn_alert region=apac-sg hosts=[h-12,h-13] score=9.1 window=5m
sam: quick proposal: softcap behavior -> reduce concurrency 25%, route new allocs to preemptible-warmpool, cooldown 60m, no hard kills. revert after 12m healthy.
claire: PromQL sketch: `sum by(tenant)(rate(gpu_slab_allocs[5m])) / sum by(tenant)(gpu_slab_active_bytes) > 0.09` correlate with `increase(nvlink_retries_total[5m]) > 20`
ravi: excellent. runbook: https://internal.runbook/slab-softcap (trigger -> soft-throttle -> notify tenant -> escalate after 3 triggers/day)
finance: tagging for billing: if tenant triggers >2 warmpool moves in 7d open cost review / invoice.
oncall-bot: @oncall paging: softcap triggered for recommender-prod in apac-sg. follow runbook above.
